capabilities: import GitLab issues as vault notes
refresh imported issues automatically on a 15-minute schedule
remove notes for issues no longer returned by GitLab
filter issues using GitLab Issues List API queries
customise issue note format with a Handlebars template
extras: Notes are read-only and will be deleted from the vault if they stop being returned by GitLab; imports start 30 seconds after Obsidian launches.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull GitLab issues into the vault as notes or keep them up to date with the tracker.

relations.evidence: You can then use the excellent DataView Plugin to create lists of upcoming issues

requires.name: GitLab Personal Access Token with API scope

summary: Imports GitLab issues into a vault as read-only notes, refreshed every 15 minutes and formatted with custom Handlebars templates.
